outcome: availability of emergency obstetric and neonatal care services
utilization of emergency obstetric and neonatal care services
quality of emergency obstetric and neonatal care services
cohort: All public and private health facilities in Burkina Faso in 2010 and a sample of 812 health facilities in 2014
finding: The two surveys did not show a significant improvement in the availability, utilization, and quality of maternal and neonatal healthcare services between 2010 and 2014.
